name: FREE - Create and validate multi-platform social media content from Telegram with OpenAI

parameters.content:
## FREE - Create and validate multi-platform social media content from Telegram with OpenAI

### How it works

This workflow receives a social media topic from Telegram, validates the input, and applies default content settings such as tone, audience, language, and call to action. It uses OpenAI to generate platform-specific captions, parses and scores them, then either validates the final content or retries generation when quality checks fail. A success or failure report is formatted and sent back to the Telegram chat when a chat ID is available.

### Setup steps

- Configure Telegram bot credentials for both the Telegram trigger and Telegram send nodes.
- Configure OpenAI credentials and choose the model/settings used by the caption generation and regeneration nodes.
- Review the Content Settings node to set the desired tone, target audience, language, and call to action.
- Confirm the code nodes contain the correct platform validation rules, content quality scoring logic, retry limit, and report formatting.
- Make sure incoming Telegram messages provide a usable topic and that the workflow preserves the Telegram chat_id for replies.

### Customization

You can customize the supported platforms, caption length rules, quality score thresholds, retry count, content tone, language, and the Telegram usage/help and final report messages.

## Receive Telegram topic

Captures an incoming Telegram message and normalizes the topic and chat ID into fields used by the rest of the workflow.

## Validate topic input

Checks whether the Telegram message contains a valid topic, applies content defaults for valid requests, and sends usage help for invalid input.

## Generate and parse captions

Uses OpenAI to create the initial multi-platform social captions, then parses the model output into a structured format for scoring.

## Score content quality

Calculates a quality score for the parsed captions and branches the workflow based on whether the generated content passes the threshold.

## Build success report

For captions that pass quality checks, validates platform-specific requirements and builds the final content report.

## Retry or fail generation

Handles the failed-quality branch by deciding whether another generation attempt is allowed, regenerating captions when possible, or creating a failed content report when retries are exhausted.

## Send Telegram response

Formats either the successful content pack or failure report for Telegram, checks that a chat is available, and sends the result back to the user.

values.content:
=You are a multi-platform social media content strategist.

Create platform-specific social media content based on the topic and settings below.

CONTENT TOPIC:
{{ $json.topic }}

CONTENT SETTINGS:
Tone: {{ $json.tone }}
Target audience: {{ $json.target_audience }}
Language: {{ $json.language }}
Brand voice: {{ $json.brand_voice }}
Call to action: {{ $json.call_to_action }}
Include emojis: {{ $json.include_emojis }}
Include hashtags: {{ $json.include_hashtags }}

GENERAL RULES:
- Adapt the content specifically for each platform instead of copying the same caption.
- Follow the requested tone, audience, language, and brand voice.
- If Language is "Same as topic", use the same language as the content topic.
- If Include emojis is false, do not use emojis.
- If Include hashtags is false, do not use hashtags.
- Do not invent facts that are not present in the topic.
- Use the call to action naturally when appropriate.
- Avoid repetitive wording across platforms.

INSTAGRAM:
- Engaging and polished
- 2-4 short paragraphs
- Maximum 600 characters
- If hashtags are enabled, add exactly 5 relevant hashtags

TIKTOK:
- Short, punchy and attention-grabbing
- Maximum 180 characters
- If hashtags are enabled, add exactly 4 relevant hashtags

YOUTUBE SHORTS:
- Create a title and description
- Title maximum 70 characters
- Description maximum 250 characters
- If hashtags are enabled, add exactly 3 relevant hashtags to the description

THREADS:
- Conversational and natural
- Maximum 300 characters
- If hashtags are enabled, use no more than 2 hashtags

Return ONLY valid JSON in exactly this format:

{
  "instagram": "Instagram caption",
  "tiktok": "TikTok caption",
  "youtube_title": "YouTube Shorts title",
  "youtube_description": "YouTube Shorts description",
  "threads": "Threads post"
}

=You are a social media content quality editor.

The previously generated social media content failed quality control.

Your job is to fix the detected problems while preserving good parts of the original content.

CONTENT TOPIC:
{{ $json.topic }}

CONTENT SETTINGS:
Tone: {{ $json.tone }}
Target audience: {{ $json.target_audience }}
Language: {{ $json.language }}
Brand voice: {{ $json.brand_voice }}
Call to action: {{ $json.call_to_action }}
Include emojis: {{ $json.include_emojis }}
Include hashtags: {{ $json.include_hashtags }}

QUALITY SCORE:
{{ $json.quality_score }}

DETECTED QUALITY ISSUES:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.quality_issues) }}

CURRENT CONTENT:

Instagram:
{{ $json.instagram }}

TikTok:
{{ $json.tiktok }}

YouTube Shorts title:
{{ $json.youtube_title }}

YouTube Shorts description:
{{ $json.youtube_description }}

Threads:
{{ $json.threads }}

FIXING RULES:

- Fix every issue listed in DETECTED QUALITY ISSUES.
- Preserve content that already satisfies the requirements.
- Do not invent facts that are not present in the topic.
- Make each platform version meaningfully different.
- Follow the requested tone, target audience, language, brand voice and call to action.
- If Language is "Same as topic", use the same language as the original topic.
- If Include emojis is false, do not use emojis.
- If Include hashtags is false, do not use hashtags.

INSTAGRAM:
- Maximum 600 characters
- Engaging and polished
- 2-4 short paragraphs
- If hashtags are enabled, use exactly 5 relevant hashtags

TIKTOK:
- Maximum 180 characters
- Short, punchy and attention-grabbing
- If hashtags are enabled, use exactly 4 relevant hashtags

YOUTUBE SHORTS:
- Title maximum 70 characters
- Description maximum 250 characters
- If hashtags are enabled, use exactly 3 relevant hashtags in the description

THREADS:
- Maximum 300 characters
- Conversational and natural
- If hashtags are enabled, use no more than 2 hashtags

Return ONLY valid JSON in exactly this format:

{
  "instagram": "Instagram caption",
  "tiktok": "TikTok caption",
  "youtube_title": "YouTube Shorts title",
  "youtube_description": "YouTube Shorts description",
  "threads": "Threads post"
}

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    // Needed to send the failed result back to the same Telegram user
    chat_id: data.chat_id ?? null,

    status: 'failed_after_retries',

    message:
      'The generated content did not pass quality control after the maximum number of regeneration attempts.',

    source: {
      topic: data.topic ?? ''
    },

    quality_score: data.quality_score ?? 0,
    quality_status: 'failed_after_retries',
    quality_issues: data.quality_issues ?? [],
    quality_issue_count: data.quality_issue_count ?? 0,

    content: {
      instagram:
        data.instagram ??
        data.instagram_caption ??
        '',

      tiktok:
        data.tiktok ??
        data.tiktok_caption ??
        '',

      youtube_title:
        data.youtube_title ??
        '',

      youtube_description:
        data.youtube_description ??
        '',

      threads:
        data.threads ??
        data.threads_post ??
        ''
    },

    settings: {
      tone: data.tone ?? '',
      target_audience: data.target_audience ?? '',
      language: data.language ?? '',
      brand_voice: data.brand_voice ?? '',
      call_to_action: data.call_to_action ?? '',
      include_emojis: data.include_emojis ?? false,
      include_hashtags: data.include_hashtags ?? false
    },

    recommendation:
      'Review the detected quality issues, adjust the topic or content settings, and try again.'
  }
}];
